If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios

MIXED-SIGNAL: the hand-drawn ring oscillator, imported as a hard macro.
tt-support-tools generates src/user_config.json and merges it OVER this
file, but only for the keys it owns (DESIGN_NAME, VERILOG_FILES, DIE_AREA,
FP_DEF_TEMPLATE, VDD_PIN, GND_PIN, RT_MAX_LAYER). Everything below
survives into the LibreLane run. analog/README.md describes the block.
Built by analog/layout/build_tt_analog_ring.py (GDS + LEF from the same
constants); Liberty measured in ngspice by analog/char/characterize.py.
Placed by hand: x on the site grid (2.88 + 0.48k), y on the row grid
(3.78k), 90.72 x 56.7 um under the top edge of the 1x2 tile (202.08 x
313.74; core top at 309.96 = 253.26 + 56.7). Its pins face south into
the logic; its Metal4 supply bars span the full width so the PDN's
TopMetal1 straps (VPWR at 16.48 + 38.87n, VGND 6.2 further, 2.2 wide)
cross both bars twice. x is chosen so neither macro edge falls on a
strap: a strap clipped by the edge gets no via (PDN-0110).
(A '//' key is only stripped at the top level - LibreLane rejects one
inside the Macro object itself.)
Keep the placer, and every route, away from the analog block. The LEF
already blocks Metal1..Metal4 over the macro; the halo keeps standard
cells from crowding right up against the guard ring, and keeps the
PDN's own straps off it except where they are hooked on purpose.
The PDN halo stays at zero: a halo keeps the grid's straps away from
the macro, and the macro's straps have to be reachable from it.
Hook the macro's supplies to the tile PDN.
<instance_rx> <vdd_net> <gnd_net> <vdd_pin> <gnd_pin>
The macro grid vias between PDN_VERTICAL_LAYER and PDN_HORIZONTAL_LAYER.
The tile's grid is TopMetal1 (vertical) and, with FP_PDN_MULTILAYER off,
PDN_HORIZONTAL_LAYER is used for NOTHING ELSE - see pdn_cfg.tcl, where
the horizontal stripe and the core ring are both inside the multilayer
branch. Naming Metal4 here is therefore how the macro's Metal4 power
straps get vias up to the TopMetal1 grid, and it changes nothing else.
Left at its TopMetal2 default the macro grid has no layer in common with
the macro and PDN quits with PDN-0232 then PDN-0233.
Timing: the eight ring outputs are clocks of their own, asynchronous
to clk and to each other. constraints.sdc sources LibreLane's base.sdc
and adds them; the same file serves PnR and signoff.
